name: qa-crawler
description: Autonomous QA coverage crawler: maps the whole app and inspects every node (the inverted maze), with a deterministic engine + ledger + pattern library exposed over MCP, plus a skill and orchestrator/worker subagents.

playwright.description: Playwright MCP driving the SAME Neko browser over CDP — generic browser tools (navigate/click/snapshot) for ad-hoc steps, visible in Neko. Set QA_NEKO_CDP to a remote Neko's endpoint. Remove this block to use the qa-crawler engine alone.
